title: Maine BayCycle

services.name: BayCycle Cruise
services.desc: Bring your friends on Maine's first and only human powered party boat. With ten pedal stations and seating for five more, you can book individual seats or the whole boat for a private tour of Portland. Perfect for wedding parties, birthdays or just an afternoon on the water, Maine BayCycle offers an experience like no other. Monday-Thursday Daytime $45 per Adult $520 Private Charter (15 adults max) Monday-Thursday Sunset Cruise $50 per Adult $585 Private Charter (15 adults max) Friday-Sunday $50 per Adult $585 Private Charter (15 adults max) Must be 21+ with valid ID Available Public or Private Charters · 1.5 Hours · Runs Daily!

quotes.author: erin m
quotes.text: Fun cruise around the harbor. Went for a The Office themed bachelorette party. Decent amount of time. Loved that there was ice to put drinks in and ways to secure your bags. You can hook up your own music if you like. Communication was very good. Neil our captain was fun and great!

quotes.author: Chris Elgee
quotes.text: Neil does a fantastic job! If you want a guided tour of the area, he's your guy. Or if you just want to party on a boat, he's good for that too. (-:

quotes.author: Ashlee Mitchell
quotes.text: We had an amazing time! Our guide was very informative and kind. The tour was beautiful and we're so thankful we chose to do this on our girls trip!

quotes.author: Lawrence Perrault
quotes.text: The sunset cruise was an amazing time. Boat ride was perfect length of time. We all had a great time and would highly recommend it. Thanks!!

quotes.author: Joanna Fox
quotes.text: What a wonderful way to cruise around Casco Bay ! Highly recommend.
